baseline.description: Capture TSC error baseline before any changes. Post-gates compare against this.
baseline.command: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep "error TS" | sort > /tmp/ff_tsc_baseline.txt; echo "baseline captured: $(wc -l < /tmp/ff_tsc_baseline.txt) errors"

global-constraints.c: TypeScript strict. No any. Imports via @farkle/shared and @farkle/engine aliases only. Never relative paths to packages/.
No Math.random() game events. No better-sqlite3. No framer-motion (use motion/react). No setInterval for cascade or energy (use setTimeout recursion and RAF).
No activeBombs array. No SpawnPool class. No recoverDeadBoard(). No React.StrictMode. No rallyGridSize().
No emoji or non-ASCII in TypeScript source. No page title FARKLE FRENZY in GameScreen. No SP_FREE/SP_CASINO (use SOLO_FREE/SOLO_CASINO).
Analytics inserts are fire-and-forget, never awaited. Gear icon is U+2699 text only. Not emoji. Not Lucide.
Output raw TypeScript only. No markdown fences. Do not escape backticks.

tsc-diff.description: Reused by all post-gates. Pass if no new error lines vs baseline.
tsc-diff.command: comm -23 <(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep "error TS" | sort) <(sort /tmp/ff_tsc_baseline.txt) > /tmp/ff_new_errors.txt; if [ -s /tmp/ff_new_errors.txt ]; then echo "NEW TSC ERRORS:"; cat /tmp/ff_new_errors.txt; exit 1; fi; echo "TSC diff clean"

Imports: SixPoolManager,hasValidChain,stepGravity,spawnTiles,normalizeTiles from '@farkle/engine/gridUtils'. scoreFarkle from '@farkle/engine/farkleScorer'. types from '@farkle/shared/types'. insertChainDecision,insertSession from './analytics'. crypto from 'node:crypto'. sql from 'sql.js'. NEVER better-sqlite3.
export class GameRoom { Fields: grid:Cell[][],players:Map<string,Player>,phase:string,activePlayerId:string,unbanked:number,banked:Record<string,number>,multiplierStep:number,farklePool:number,vault:number,roundNumber:number,globalMode:'PRIME'|'FRENZY',playerEnergies:Record<string,number>,anchorPlayerId:string|null,sessionId:string,chainCount:number,serverSeed:string,serverSeedHash:string,combinedSeed:string|null,pool:SixPoolManager,lastChainMs:Record<string,number>,timerHandle:ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>|null
constructor(gridSize:number,csprng:()=>number): generate serverSeed=crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'). serverSeedHash=SHA256(serverSeed). init pool=new SixPoolManager(gridSize,csprng).
handleMessage(playerId:string,msg:{type:string,[k:string]:unknown}):void switch msg.type: 'SUBMIT_CHAIN': validate phase==='IDLE' and playerId===activePlayerId and Date.now()-lastChainMs[playerId]>=100. lastChainMs[playerId]=Date.now(). score=scoreFarkle(faces). Apply round flow (len6+score>0=CONTINUE, len2-5+score>0=AUTO-BANK+ROUND_END, score===0=FARKLE). Call insertChainDecision({...}) no await. Run cascade. Broadcast CHAIN_RESULT+BOARD_UPDATE. 'BANK': unbanked->banked[playerId], multiplierStep=0, ROUND_END. insertChainDecision decision:BANK no await. 'PASS': Rally. If Conductor role multiplierStep=Math.min(5,multiplierStep+1). Transfer to next player. 'VOTE_REACT': broadcast VOTE_UPDATE. 'INITIATE_HEIST': check vault>=5000 and playerEnergies[playerId]>=50. Start HEIST_WINDOW_MS=5000 timer. 'LEAVE_ROOM': mark disconnected. Broadcast PLAYER_DISCONNECTED.
cascade(): private. async. stepGravity->spawnTiles(pool)->normalizeTiles. setTimeout recursion 80ms. After stable: if !hasValidChain(grid) pool.reshuffle() + respawn. Broadcast BOARD_UPDATE each step. NEVER setInterval.
applyChainEnergy(playerId:string,len:number,wild:boolean): update playerEnergies[playerId]. If any player>150 set globalMode='FRENZY'. Broadcast ENERGY_UPDATE.
setClientSeed(playerId:string,seed:string): store seed. When all players submitted: combinedSeed=SHA256(serverSeed+seeds.join('')). pool.reseed(combinedSeed).
endSession(): computeSkillScore from session totals. insertSession({...}) no await. broadcast SEED_REVEAL:{serverSeed}.
startTurnTimer(ms:number): timerHandle=setTimeout(()=>this.handleMessage(activePlayerId,{type:'BANK'}),ms). clearTurnTimer(): if timerHandle clearTimeout(timerHandle). }
No activeBombs array. No Math.random(). No setInterval. No relative paths to packages/. sql.js for local room/player storage. Import paths @farkle/ only.
